v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Ille homo * qui dícitur Iesus, lutum fecit ex sputo, et linívit óculos meos, et modo vídeo.
text.en: The Man that is called Jesus * made clay of His Spittle, and anointed mine eyes, and now I do see.

text.la: Páteant aures misericórdiæ tuæ, Dómine, précibus supplicántium: et, ut peténtibus desideráta concédas, fac eos, quæ tibi sunt plácita, postuláre.
text.en: Let thy merciful ears, O Lord, be open unto the prayers of all them that entreat thee, and that Thou mayest grant us ever such things as we ask, teach us ever to ask such things as are pleasing in thy sight.

office.title: Feria Quarta infra Hebd IV in Quadr
